title: 第183章 绝无可能第182章 谁的诅咒
lines: 推导至此，狄娥尼索斯只觉得浑身一冷，心直往下沉。
并非不是盖亚就能让人庆幸。以阿耳忒弥斯女神那出了名的冷酷性子与狠辣手段，她发起怒来，绝对能把尼萨山的萨堤罗斯统统剥皮抽筋、曝尸荒野。
更何况，那位狩猎女神阿耳忒弥斯，不正是他名义上的同父异母的姐姐吗？
“你们这帮混账，到底背着我干了什么好事？！”
见狄娥尼索斯动了真怒，安斐罗斯也慌了神，结结巴巴地拼命搜寻着记忆：
“额......就是在山里寻欢作乐，放了场火，打了些猎，接着又快活了一阵，跟人斗了场狠，然后就离开了尼萨山......”
不等安斐罗斯说完，狄娥尼索斯已经一巴掌狠狠甩在了自己的脑门上。
“老师，全对上了。这帮蠢货一定是玩昏了头，不知不觉间闯出了尼萨山，一路撒野到了阿耳忒弥斯女神的神山领地！”
西勒诺斯沉吟片刻，重重地叹了口气：
“狄娥尼索斯，你的推测恐怕八九不离十了。你的养母们是看在你的面子上才对他们多加容忍，可若是在阿耳忒弥斯女神的山头干出那种勾当......”
西勒诺斯说到此处便顿住了，显然也是联想到了某些极其血腥恐怖的画面，不愿再往下说。
虽然只是两人的推测，但光是想想，就足以让人眼前一黑。
狄娥尼索斯此刻恨不得立刻冲过去，把那帮中了瘟疫之咒，正躺在地上哼唧的蠢货统统暴揍一顿。
“怎么不直接死在外面，真是个个嫌命长！”
面对狄娥尼索斯的滔天怒火，安斐罗斯极有眼色地选择了闭嘴。
他很清楚，现在只要敢多顶一句嘴，绝对会被狄娥尼索斯当场扒下一层皮来。
‘当时大家都喝断片了......其实我也不太记得自己到底去没去过那地方。嗯......还是烂在肚子里吧......’
他在心中暗暗打定了主意，面孔上挤出一抹讨好的笑容。
万幸的是，狄娥尼索斯此时根本无暇顾及这个记忆模糊，合伙惹事的狐朋狗友。
眼下最要紧的，还是躺在树底下的那一副副烂摊子。虽然这帮家伙死有余辜，但好歹也是打小陪他一同长大的兄弟。
‘不对，还是别叫兄弟了，丢不起这神脸。’
“老师，可有破解之法？”
狄娥尼索斯深吸一口气，压下心头的怒火，沉声问道。
“依我看，放弃他们......或许才是上策。”
西勒诺斯话语中带着无奈与沉重。
“西勒诺斯大人！！”安斐罗斯急得大喊。
“你这不知死活的蠢货！闯下这种天大祸，你还有脸在这大呼小叫？”
西勒诺斯厉声喝道，声音如惊雷般在林间炸开：
“那可是阿耳忒弥斯女神！你这条小命能保住就该谢天谢地了。若非你不是萨堤罗斯之身，恐怕早就变成一具尸体了！”
content_en:
After deducing this, Dionysus felt a chill all over his body and his heart sank.
It’s not that Gaia makes people happy. With the famous cold temperament and ruthless methods of the goddess Artemis, when she gets angry, she can definitely skin and cramp all the Satyros in Mount Nyssa and expose their corpses to the wilderness.
What's more, isn't Artemis, the goddess of hunting, his half-sister in name?
"What good things did you bastards do behind my back?!"
Seeing that Dionysus was really angry, Amphilos also panicked, stammering and desperately searching for his memory:
"Well... I just had fun in the mountains, set a fire, hunted some, had fun for a while, fought hard with others, and then left Mount Nissa..."
"Crack!"
Before Amphilos could finish speaking, Dionysus had already slapped him hard on the forehead.
"Teacher, it's all right. These fools must have lost their minds and unknowingly broke out of Mount Nysa and went wild all the way to the sacred mountain territory of the goddess Artemis!"
"Well..."
Silenus pondered for a moment and sighed heavily:
"Dionysus, your guess is probably quite accurate. Your adoptive mothers are tolerant of them because of your face, but if you do that kind of thing on the top of the mountain of the goddess Artemis..."
Silenus paused when he said this, obviously thinking of some extremely bloody and terrifying scenes, and did not want to go on.
Although it is just the speculation of the two people, just thinking about it is enough to make people's eyes darken.
Dionysus could not wait to rush over immediately and beat up all the idiots who were lying on the ground and groaning under the curse of the plague.
"Why don't you just die outside? You really don't want to live long!"
"..."
Facing Dionysus' raging anger, Amphilos chose to shut up with a wink.
He knew very well that if he dared to talk back now, Dionysus would definitely peel off a layer of his skin on the spot.
‘Everyone was drunk at that time... Actually, I don’t remember whether I went to that place or not. Hmm...it's better to rot in the stomach...'
He secretly made up his mind and put on a flattering smile on his face.
Fortunately, Dionysus had no time to care about this friend with vague memory who was causing trouble together.
The most important thing right now was the mess lying under the tree. Although these guys deserved their death, they were still brothers who grew up with him.
‘No, it’s better not to call him brother, we can’t afford to lose face like this. ’
"Teacher, is there any way to solve this problem?"
Dionysus took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in his heart, and asked in a deep voice.
"In my opinion, giving them up...may be the best thing to do."
Silenus' words were filled with helplessness and heaviness.
"Lord Silenus!!" Amphilos shouted anxiously.
"You reckless fool! You have caused such a huge disaster, and you still have the nerve to scream here?"
Silenus shouted sharply, his voice exploding in the forest like thunder:
"That's the goddess Artemis! Thank God for saving your life. If you weren't the body of Satyrus, you would have turned into a corpse long ago!"
"...Uh."
title_en: Chapter 183: Absolutely Impossible Chapter 182: Whose Curse
